# Supplied DaziPet classroom concept assets

All visuals come from the supplied DaziPet_Website_Images directory. They are classroom AI concept illustrations, not photographs of manufactured products or proof of tested capabilities. Original source assets are unchanged.

- brand/logo.png: supplied transparent brand mark
- brand/hero-desktop.jpg: supplied original desktop banner converted to JPEG for delivery
- products/dada-cloud.png: Cloud / Long-Pile Plush
- products/dada-sun.png: Sun / Short-Pile Plush
- products/dada-star.png: Star / Silicone
- products/dada-modular-design.png: modular core and skin concept
- products/dada-complete-set.png: retained reference only, not rendered as a live price
- lifestyle/dada-desktop.png: desktop use concept
- lifestyle/dada-bag-charm.png: portable use concept

Product paths and current prices are configured in ../config.js. Product images depict assembled concepts; an Extra Skin order excludes the electronic core. The site states this alongside the purchase controls.
